recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: UK seaside towns get more control: Margate leads the way in coastal town revival
recentItems.description:
The UK government is promising the country’s seaside towns greater control over their own futures, with calls for communities to have the power to “reimagine themselves” for the 21st century. Margate, on England’s southeast coast, is often held up as a model of how a traditional seaside resort can reinvent itself. Once known primarily for its beaches and tourism, the town has undergone a transformation as new businesses, artists and visitors have helped reshape its identity. 

AlJazeera’s Sonia Gallego reports.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: France-UK migration : Coastal village of Hardelot becoming a new hotspot
recentItems.description:
Northern France has become a new route for migrants trying to reach the UK, as increased security at traditional Channel crossing points pushes people towards alternative routes. In the coastal village of Hardelot, about 60 kilometres south of Calais, frequent police patrols and restrictions on NGOs have contributed to the area emerging as a new hotspot for migrants.

Al Jazeera’s Bernard Smith reports from Boulogne.

recentItems.title: Nepal flood survivors find shelter: Thousands of children need aid
recentItems.description:
As rescue efforts continue in Nepal, survivors from remote villages are finding temporary shelter and assistance. Among them are children—including some who have been orphaned. Barnaby Lo reports from Bidur in central Nepal.
